topic: Splitting a utility bill among roommates
core_question: Five roommates split a $150 utility bill evenly. How much does each person owe? (secondary: On a map, the scale is 1 inch equals 25 miles. If two cities are 6 inches apart on the map, how far apart are they in real life, in miles?)
answer_summary: each person's share of $30 (a $150 bill split 5 ways); after the topic shift: the cities are 150 miles apart (6 inches times 25 miles per inch)
persona: dramatic and exasperated; writing in full careful sentences
